title: YouTube Launches New AI Tools for Creators! 🎬
body: YouTube Launches New AI Tools for Creators! 🎬

YouTube announced yesterday at its "Made on YouTube" event new AI tools for creators, covering every step of video-making: finding ideas, editing clips, managing comments, and protecting creators' identities, through YouTube Studio, Shorts, and the "YouTube Create" app.

AI now helps creators from the first idea to the final edit. And the "Ask YouTube" feature means you can ask a question about a video and get an answer — and now it also helps you buy the products shown in videos. Shorts is also getting a new series format: short videos released in episodes, like a vertical TV show.
Do you watch short videos, or do you prefer long ones? 📺
